verdict.rationale: BigQuery sharing (formerly Analytics Hub) is documented as a data exchange platform for securely sharing, discovering, and accessing data across organizational boundaries without replicating it. Listings likewise share data without copying, and can be monetized on Google Cloud Marketplace. Together these directly cover sharing datasets with another organization without copies or export pipelines. Missing for 10: no explicit statement that subscribers see live updates (implied only by 'without replicating'), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-org sharing in practice.
